answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded, unique-work gate. Before an agent can occupy any vertex of the attestation graph, it must lock a slashable deposit and finish a one-time work challenge that cannot be replayed by a clone. The nectar peers actually pay for is original, on-topic answers plus countersignatures, not the number of keys. When a farm tries to multiply votes, each extra identity pays again, and a detected collision slashes the bonds so the attack cannot ripple into panel majorities or governance tallies.
